statements.impact_statement: CVE-2025-10966: when curl did SFTP through its wolfSSH backend, it skipped host verification, so a man-in-the-middle went undetected. Only builds that use the wolfSSH backend are affected, and upstream curl 8.17.0 fixed it by dropping wolfSSH support: https://curl.se/docs/CVE-2025-10966.html, https://github.com/curl/curl/commit/b011e3fcfb06d6c0278595ee2ee297036fbe9793. No published build of this owner has an SSH backend at all: Alpine's curl APKBUILD configures --without-libssh2 and enables no other SSH library (https://github.com/alpinelinux/aports/blob/856d76205ed1b7f875d32fd7b72eb93912f32acd/main/curl/APKBUILD). Unpacked every published curl package for Alpine 3.23 in the DHI Alpine repository: 8.17.0-r1, 8.18.0-r0, 8.19.0-r0, 8.20.0-r0, 8.20.0-r1, 8.21.0-r0, 8.22.0-r0, 8.23.0-r0 and 8.23.0-r1, each for x86_64 and aarch64, as curl, libcurl, curl-dev, curl-static, curl-dbg, curl-doc, curl-fish-completion and curl-zsh-completion. Their programs and shared libraries are the curl program and the libcurl.so.4 shared library, both dynamically linked against musl. libcurl links OpenSSL, zlib, c-ares, nghttp2, libidn2, libpsl, zstd and brotli; 8.17.0-r1 and 8.18.0-r0 also link nghttp3; no ELF file links an SSH library (libssh2, libssh or wolfSSH), an LDAP library or GnuTLS. curl-static ships the static libcurl.a, whose members are all libcurl's own object files; curl-dbg holds only detached debug information for curl and libcurl. No package contains a PE or Mach-O file. In every libcurl.a, the SSH source objects define no symbols (8.19.0-r0's vssh object carries only the scp and sftp scheme descriptors), and none of the 8.17.0-r1 and later archives has a wolfSSH object. The wolfSSH SFTP code the advisory describes is not in any build.

CVE-2025-10966: when curl did SFTP through its wolfSSH backend, it skipped host verification, so a man-in-the-middle went undetected. Only builds that use the wolfSSH backend are affected, and upstream curl 8.17.0 fixed it by dropping wolfSSH support: https://curl.se/docs/CVE-2025-10966.html, https://github.com/curl/curl/commit/b011e3fcfb06d6c0278595ee2ee297036fbe9793. Debian builds curl with libssh2 and does not use the wolfSSH backend: https://security-tracker.debian.org/tracker/CVE-2025-10966. Unpacked all 51 binary packages published from the curl source in the DHI Debian repository: curl 8.14.1 in its three published Debian revisions, built from Debian's 8.14.1-2+deb13u5 and 8.14.1-2+deb13u7 sources, for amd64 and arm64, namely curl, libcurl4t64, libcurl3t64-gnutls, libcurl4-openssl-dev, libcurl4-gnutls-dev and libcurl4-doc, and the debug-symbol packages curl-dbgsym, libcurl4t64-dbgsym and libcurl3t64-gnutls-dbgsym. Their ELF files are the curl program and the libcurl.so.4.8.0 (OpenSSL) and libcurl-gnutls.so.4.8.0 (GnuTLS) shared libraries, each dynamically linked against the system libc.so.6, plus detached debug-information files in the debug-symbol packages. The development packages also ship the static archives libcurl.a and libcurl-gnutls.a, each with 179 members that are all libcurl's own object files. No package contains a PE or Mach-O file. Both libcurl shared libraries link libssh2.so.1 for SCP and SFTP; no ELF file links libssh or wolfSSH. In each static archive the wolfssh and libssh objects are empty (608 bytes on amd64, 808 bytes on arm64) and define no symbols, while the SSH code is in the libssh2 object. The wolfSSH SFTP code the advisory describes is not compiled into any build.
